head: Hurricane preparedness app Batten Down plans before and after a storm
dek: Batten Down is a $1.99 iPhone app for families and small businesses that covers getting ready for a hurricane, checking in during one and making insurance claims after. It was #26 among paid Weather apps on the US App Store on 20 November.
details: It has prep checklists with a readiness score, a supply tracker that counts days of water and food, an evacuation plan with links to official zone and shelter information, and US National Weather Service alerts. A family check-in sends an "I'm safe" or "Need help" text through Messages. After a storm it keeps a room-by-room inventory with photos and a damage and claim log, and makes PDF reports for your insurer. There's no account, no ads and no tracking; it's made by Take The Wheel LLC, came out on 19 November and says it isn't an official emergency service.
where: App Store, iPhone (iOS 15 or later), $1.99; alerts for the US
means: If you live where hurricanes hit, it keeps your checklist, supplies, plan and insurance records in one place on your phone.
todo: Search Batten Down on the App Store and fill in the home inventory with photos now, before a storm; in an emergency, follow local officials and call 911.
